name: knowledge-tool
description: A token-efficient Codex learning plugin with resumable roadmaps, mastery tracking, sprint tutoring, and external study folders.

interface.shortDescription: Learn faster with compact progress and mastery tracking.
interface.longDescription: KnowledgeTool guides Codex through practical sprint learning or deep research workflows. It tracks course coverage, knowledge-point mastery, recent trends, retrieval evidence, and next tasks while keeping full learning history outside the active context. User study content is always written outside the plugin source into configurable learning directories.
